name: org.signalcheckerhq/signalcheckerhq
title: SignalCheckerHQ
description: Check crypto signal calls, liquidation price, position size and safe leverage on real prices.

tools.name: check_signal_call
tools.description: Replays a crypto trading signal (a long/short call with entry, stop and targets, as posted in Telegram or Discord) on real exchange prices from the time it was posted, and returns what really happened: whether the entry filled, which targets were hit, whether the stop or liquidation came first, and the result after fees (and on margin when leverage is given). Use it when someone shares a signal and asks if it really won. Covers up to the first 3 calls in the text; calls must be at least 1 hour and at most about 30 days old.

text.description: The signal post as written, e.g. 'BTC LONG entry 91500 SL 89800 TP1 93000 TP2 94500 10x'.

posted_at.description: When the call was posted, ISO 8601 (e.g. 2026-11-20T14:00:00Z). Needed unless the text itself contains the date and time.

lang.description: Language of the answer. Default en.

tools.name: liquidation_price
tools.description: Calculates the liquidation price of an isolated-margin crypto futures position (long or short) from entry price and leverage, the distance to it, and, if a stop-loss is given, whether liquidation would come before the stop and the highest leverage the stop allows. Pure calculation, no market data.

side.description: Position direction: long (profits when price rises) or short (profits when price falls).

entry.description: Entry price of the position, in the quote currency (e.g. USD).

leverage.description: Leverage multiple, e.g. 10 for 10x. Isolated margin is assumed.

stop.description: Optional stop-loss price. If given, the answer says whether liquidation comes before the stop.

tools.name: position_size
tools.description: Works out how big a trade can be so that hitting the stop-loss loses only the chosen share of the account, fees included, plus the margin needed at a given leverage and whether liquidation comes before the stop. Pure calculation.

risk_pct.description: Share of the account to risk, in percent (e.g. 1).

stop.description: Stop-loss price. Below the entry for a long, above it for a short; the side is read from this.

leverage.description: Leverage used to work out the margin needed. Optional, default 1 (no leverage).

fee_pct.description: Fee per side in percent. Default 0.05.

tools.name: leverage_survival
tools.description: Tests every hour of roughly the last 1,000 hours as an entry on real hourly prices of a coin and reports, for 2x to 100x, the share of entries that would have been liquidated within the holding time by normal price swings (isolated margin), and the highest leverage that 90% and 99% of entries survived. Use it to answer 'what leverage is safe for this coin?' with data.

side.description: Position direction to test. Default long.

hold_hours.description: How long the position is held. Default 24.
